description: Test class for DefaultNotesRepository, verifying CRUD operations, synchronization, local persistence, and search features in the notes app.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepositorySyncAndCrudTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing CRUD, sync, persistence, and search functionalities of DefaultNotesRepository.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database, API, and repository before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the in-memory database after each test.

methods.name: crud_create_update_delete_are_reflected_in_observeNote_and_observeNotes
methods.description: Verifies that create, update, delete operations are correctly reflected in observed notes and handle tombstones appropriately.

methods.name: offline_persistence_room_keeps_data_across_repository_instances
methods.description: Ensures data persists across multiple instances of the repository using Room.

methods.name: sync_uploads_dirty_items_and_marks_clean
methods.description: Checks that dirty notes are uploaded and marked as clean after sync, and remote reflects changes.

methods.name: sync_last_write_wins_does_not_overwrite_local_when_local_is_newer_than_remote
methods.description: Verifies local updates are preserved over remote older updates during sync.

methods.name: sync_tombstone_deletion_is_uploaded_and_purged_locally_and_visible_to_remote
methods.description: Tests that deletions (tombstones) are uploaded to remote, purged locally, and visible remotely.

methods.name: search_escapes_like_wildcards_percent_and_underscore
methods.description: Validates that search queries correctly handle special characters '%' and '_' as literals.

methods.name: observeNotes_is_reactive_emits_when_item_changes_to_match_filter
methods.description: Checks that observing notes reactively updates when notes change to match a query.
